Astra is all beyond the planet: the star.

# star

Type: F6.7 V
Mass: 2.40×10³⁰ kg (1.20 M☉)
Radius: 1.58×10⁶ km (1.14 R☉)
Luminosity: 7.92×10²⁶ W (2.07 L☉)
Surface Temperature: 6489 K
Main-sequence Lifetime: ~5.9×10⁹ yr
Habitable Zone: ~1.43 AU

# planet

Radius: 5415 km (0.85 R♁)
Mass: 4.72×10²⁴ kg (0.79 M♁)
Gravity: 10.78 m/s² (1.09 g♁)
Density: 7.11 g/cm³ (1.29 ρ♁)
Surface Area: 3.68×10⁸ km² (0.73 S♁)

## orbit
Semi-major Axis: 1.43 AU
Eccentricity: 0.04
Periapsis / Apoapsis: 1.37 / 1.49 AU
Orbital Period: 569.9 days (1.56 Earth years)
Orbital Velocity: 27.17 km/s
Inclination: 74° to reference plane
Axial Tilt: 23° (Earthlike seasons; adjustable)
Hill Sphere: ~292 R♁
Roche Limit (rocky moon): ~2.7 R♁
